title: Business Operations and HR Coordinator
description:
My client is a school based just outside Hastings who is looking to bring in an experienced Business Operations and HR Coordinator to join the team during a sustained period of growth.
Reporting directly to the Bursar, this role will be responsible for supporting the HR function in day-to-day activities including working with and giving guidance to all staff.

The Business Operations and HR Coordinator is responsible for supporting the efficient day-to-day running of the school's operations while coordinating key Human Resources functions. The role provides comprehensive administrative support across HR, operational management, compliance, health and safety, and facilities coordination, ensuring that systems, processes, and records are maintained to the highest standards.

The ideal candidate will have at least 2 years HR experience and be actively studying towards there CIPD qualifications. It is imperative that you have strong communication and administration skills, HR systems experience and excellent attention to detail.

You must have access to your own transport due to the location of this role.

title: HR Coordinator - Temp/FTC
description:
My client is looking for a Temporary HR Coordinator to support a busy HR team in Crawley. This is a great opportunity for someone with HR experience who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can hit the ground running.

You'll be responsible for supporting a range of HR tasks, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations during a period of increased workload or transition.

Key Responsibilities

Manage HR administration, including contracts, new starter paperwork, and employee files

Assist with coordinating recruitment activities and interview scheduling

Support onboarding and induction processes

Maintain HR systems and ensure data accuracy

Handle general employee queries and first-line HR support

Assist with absence tracking and reporting

Provide support with HR projects as needed

What We're Looking For

Experience in HR administration or coordination

Strong organisational skills and attention to detail

Confident communicator with a supportive approach

Ability to manage workload and prioritise under pressure

HR system experience is helpful

CIPD Level 3 is desirable but not essential

Why Apply?

Immediate start

Great opportunity to gain further HR experience

Welcoming and supportive team

Convenient Crawley location

title: Temporary Senior HR Administrator
company: Michael Page Business Support - Agency - Permanent
description:
As a Senior HR Admin, you'll handle essential HR tasks to keep things running smoothly, from coordinating paperwork to supporting internal processes. This temporary role is a great fit for someone who enjoys staying organised and ensuring everything is in order behind the scenes.

Client Details

A company in the human resources services and business consulting

Description
- Manage and maintain HR records and documentation accurately.
- Support onboarding and offboarding processes for employees.
- Coordinate and schedule meetings, interviews, and training sessions.
- Assist with payroll and timesheet administration.
- Respond to employee queries and provide guidance on policies.
- Ensure compliance with HR policies and procedures.
- Prepare reports and presentations related to HR activities.
- Liaise with external partners and agencies when required.

Profile

A successful Senior HR Admin should have:
- Previous experience in an HR administrative role.
- Strong organisational and multitasking skills.
- Knowledge of HR processes and best practices.
- Proficiency in using HR software and Microsoft Office tools.
- Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
- Attention to detail and a proactive approach.

Job Offer
- Weekly pay between £13.00 and £17.00 per hour, dependent on the level of experience.
- Temporary position offering flexibility.
